verdict.rationale: Zep's docs cover all three deletion levels. Single facts can be removed with `client.graph.edge.delete(uuid_=...)`. Deleting a node (per-entity) also removes all of its connected edges. Deleting a user removes all their threads and thread artifacts in one API call, which the docs present explicitly as the Right To Be Forgotten mechanism. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that deletion actually purges data, and explicit confirmation that user deletion also erases the user's Context Graph nodes and edges (the docs mention only threads and thread artifacts).
